convert_dpt_checkpoint: convert a DPT checkpoint from the original repository to HuggingFace PyTorch format
get_dpt_config: get the DPT configuration and expected output shape from a checkpoint URL
rename_key: rename a state dict key from the original DPT format to HuggingFace DPT format
read_in_q_k_v: split combined query-key-value matrices into separate query, key, and value tensors
remove_ignore_keys_: remove ignored keys like pretrained model head weights and biases from a state dict
